name: Repair Hammer
description:
A portable repair hammer. Can repair equipment. The resistance of all items in the inventory and equip windows will be recovered when used.

**How To Use**
When the hammer is clicked, the repair window will appear. Press the ok button and all items will be repaired.

**Restriction**
None

Redeem one package to a character. Its NFT is permanently locked and cannot be resold or withdrawn. The delivered items follow their native game rules.
